Gizey, a language of the North Masa-Masa group, is missing
(**hh:hw:Ajelloetal:Six-Tchadique-Central**, **hh:el:Ajello:Gizey**). Gizey is not intelligible to Masa [mcn] though many Gizey speak Masa
(**hh:el:Melis:Ham**:45). See also: Masana [mcn].
